note_tweet.text:
First impressions:  free and fast!  Like really really fast, like 5-10x faster than Grok Bot/Instinct.

They've decided to do a single chat, with temporary "side chats."  I personally hate going single-threaded, but I think it is 100% the right product choice for their userbase.

Their ideas page is better than any assistant page I've used, which I think will help users new to an AI assistant.

In general the UX feels good to use.  I think a lot of thought went into this and it feels fast and lightweight.  Very bullish!

note_tweet.text:
Personal assistant agents are going to be a very exciting AI category. It’s the first time you can have high token volume agentic use-cases that make sense for consumers. 

Lots of different approaches emerging right now, and it’s going to be hyper competitive because these agents will mediate a lot of consumer spend over time. 

But this certainly plays directly to Meta’s strengths: lots of compute required, can monetize with ads and commerce, software focused experiences so can distribute it at scale, and so on.

Having a ton of fun with this so far. Immediate reactions:

- The browser use on Muse is insanely fast. I haven't seen browser use this good yet

- Model has gotten a lot better over past week or so. Much less verbose. Feels natural bc it separates it's messages into multiply responses, emoji reacts to your messages, etc

- I love how you can ask it to create a custom avatar and it types as it works :)
